name: Ginger Noodle Soup
description: A flavorful and aromatic Asian-inspired soup featuring pork, ginger, and rice stick noodles in a savory chicken broth.
recipeIngredient: 1 pork chop, sliced into small pieces

recipeInstructions.text: In a saucepan brown pork over medium heat.
Add onion, garlic, ginger, hoisin sauce and soy sauce. Cook for 2 minutes.
Add rest of ingredients, bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes.
Garnish with green onion and coriander.

keywords: ginger noodle soup, Asian soup, pork soup

_similar.name: Ken Noodle Supper
_similar.description: A hearty chicken and noodle supper with a creamy sauce, mixed vegetables, and a blend of herbs.
recipeIngredient: 1 pkg (10 oz/300 g) frozen mixed vegetables

recipeInstructions.text: Cut chicken into 1 inch cubes. Cook in butter in a large skillet over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add onion, mushrooms, and garlic. Cook until onion is tender.
Stir in flour, salt, pepper, and herbs. Cook until thickens.
Gradually add milk, stirring constantly. Bring to a boil and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add mustard and noodles. Return to a boil.
Add frozen vegetables. Stir and cook for 10 minutes before serving.

_similar.keywords: chicken noodle supper, creamy sauce, comfort food

_similar.name: Pasta & Bean Soup
_similar.description: A hearty and flavorful soup featuring pasta, beans, and vegetables in a tomato-based broth.
recipeIngredient: 19 oz can white kidney or romano beans, drained
10 oz can chicken broth, diluted with 1 cup water
3 cups small shell pasta or macaroni

recipeInstructions.text: Place oil in a large pan over medium heat. Stir in onion, carrots, celery, and garlic. Cook, uncovered, stirring often, until onion is soft, about 5 minutes.
Add broth, tomatoes and juice, seasoning, and beans. Break up tomatoes. Increase heat to medium and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Uncover, increase heat, and bring to a boil. Add pasta or macaroni. Boil gently, uncovered, stirring often, for about 8 minutes.
If desired, add additional hot broth or water for more broth. Stir in basil and Parmesan. Serve immediately.

_similar.keywords: pasta soup, bean soup, Italian soup, vegetable broth

_similar.name: Pork Chop & Rice Casserole
_similar.description: A casserole featuring pork chops, rice, and vegetables baked in the oven.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F and spray a 9x13 inch casserole pan with cooking spray.
Put raw rice in the casserole pan.
Melt butter or margarine and sauté green onions and garlic in a frying pan, then mix with rice.
Brown pork chops on both sides and place evenly on top of the rice mixture.
Place a slice of tomato, onion, and green pepper on top of each pork chop.
Pour beef broth over the casserole and cover with foil.
Bake in the oven for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until the liquid is absorbed.

_similar.name: Mushroom Soup
_similar.description: A creamy mushroom soup made with sautéed mushrooms, onions, and garlic in a rich milk-based broth.

recipeInstructions.text: Saute butter, onion, garlic and mushrooms.
Add flour and stir together.
Add stock, sauces and milk.
Simmer until heated through (approximately 15 minutes).
Serve hot.

_similar.keywords: mushroom soup, creamy soup, comfort food

_similar.name: Veggie Basic Soup
_similar.description: A hearty vegetable soup made with a variety of vegetables and flavorful broth.

recipeInstructions.text: In a large pot, melt butter over medium heat. Cook onions, carrots, and celery until the onion is translucent.
Stir in tomatoes, beef broth, soya sauce, Worcestershire sauce, parsley, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes or until the vegetables are tender and flavors are well blended.

_similar.keywords: vegetable soup, beef broth, savory soup
